email.subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – order confirmation email
email.body_text:
Hi Neha,

Thank you for your time on our call. You wanted to find out why your customers were not receiving the order confirmation email after buying. Here is a quick summary so you have everything in one place.

What we resolved:
- We switched on the order confirmation email for your product, and you confirmed the email arrived in your inbox after your test order.

What we covered:
- The email still shows the default sender name, which can be changed in Email settings under Sender name.

What we'll do next:
- Our team will change the sender name to your brand name for you.

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-01

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Riya
FlexiFunnels Support
